title: Renew a company or partnership contractor licence
summary: This page provides information on how to renew a company or partnership contractor licence for residential building or trade work.
intro:
Companies or partnerships that contract, sub-contract or advertise to do residential building or trade work, need to be licensed.

You will receive a renewal notice for your company or partnership contractor licence several weeks before the expiry date.

You can apply to renew online or visit a Service NSW Centre.

### Check your details

To check your registration number and details, visit Verify NSW.
who_can_apply: Companies or partnerships that contract, sub-contract or advertise to do residential building or trade work need to be licensed.
what_you_need: Renewal number (as shown on your renewal notice) or your full personal details
